config.subject: EVV Update - Visit {{clearcare_visit_id}}
config.body:
Caregiver {{caregiver_name}} clocked {{event}} for visit {{clearcare_visit_id}} at {{timestamp}}.

Location: {{location.lat}}, {{location.lon}}

Please update visit status to '{{#if (eq event "clock_in")}}In Progress{{else}}Completed{{/if}}'.

- Copper AI

actions.notes: ClearCare doesn't have direct Zapier integration yet, so we use email. Agency should configure ClearCare to accept EVV updates via email.

setup_instructions.1. Create Zapier Account: Go to https://zapier.com and sign up (free tier: 5 zaps)
2. Set Up Email Parser: Create new mailbox: parse@copper.ai (or your custom domain)
Forward ClearCare notification emails to this address
Create parser rules to extract: caregiver_name, client_name, visit_date, visit_time, address
3. Create Webhook URLs: In Zapier, create new Zap with 'Webhooks by Zapier' trigger
Paste into Copper AI webhook server config
4. Connect Apps: Connect Email by Zapier (for sending EVV updates to ClearCare)
Connect Google Sheets (for logging & caregiver directory)
Connect SMS by Zapier or Twilio (for agency alerts)
5. Test Workflows: Use 'Test' button in Zapier for each step
Send test webhook payload from Copper AI server
Check Google Sheets logs populate correctly
setup_instructions.6. Enable Zaps: Turn on all 4 workflows (they're off by default)
setup_instructions.7. Monitor: Check Zapier Task History daily for any failed steps

Zapier webhook not triggering: Check webhook URL is correct in Copper AI server
Check Zapier Task History for error messages
Email parser not extracting data: Verify ClearCare emails are being forwarded to parser mailbox
Check parser rules match actual email format
Update parser template if ClearCare email format changed
Test with sample email in Zapier Email Parser dashboard
SMS not sending: Check SMS by Zapier credits (free tier: 100 SMS/month)
Verify phone numbers are in E.164 format (+1...)
Check Twilio account balance if using Twilio
Test with your own phone number first
Google Sheets not updating: Re-authenticate Google Sheets connection in Zapier
Check spreadsheet sharing permissions (Zapier needs edit access)
Check Zapier Task History for 'permission denied' errors
